data.exact_reserve_text: The (deficit)/surplus following the reassessment of claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, held at the end of the previous year are set out below:
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 (the prior-year closing gross claims outstanding) was approximately GBP 98.268m. The report contains a Technical Reserves note describing a (deficit)/surplus reassessment of prior year claims, and the Managing Agent commentary describes increased large loss activity and foreign exchange driven movements affecting the combined ratio. The report does not provide a clearly labelled GROSS prior-year movement figure that can be unambiguously extracted from the published notes; therefore a gross prior-year movement amount is not reported here.
raw_causal_phrases: largely driven by foreign currency exchange rate movements
a higher level of large losses
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, 31 Dec 2018 comparative column). The report does not contain an unambiguous, labelled GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) value that could be confidently read from the scanned pages; narrative and tables that discuss prior year movement are presented net of reinsurance or in combined/movement tables that include current year changes. A Technical Reserves note heading and the introductory sentence referencing the (deficit)/surplus of prior year claims was located (page 25) but the gross numeric movement could not be reliably extracted from the available images. No reliable, machine-readable claims development triangle values were extracted. Where figures were read from scanned tables they may be approximate; users should verify against the original PDF.
